# Vendored 2D schematic drawings

The 2D schematic view (`dist/schematic/<id>.svg` of `@accurona/elements`) of each element a
catalogue item cross-references, built by [qant-au/accurona](https://github.com/qant-au/accurona) at `f4a54d4`.
Do not edit these files: re-run `node scripts/sync-accurona.mjs`.
